title: The same intrinsic properties constitute consciousness

statements.text: Quiddities are relevant to phenomenal consciousness: consciousness is constituted at least partly by the intrinsic properties that categorically ground the dispositions of fundamental physics. Russellian monists do not agree on exactly how.

sources.quote: quidditism about consciousness, which states that quiddities are relevant to consciousness

According to Russellian monism, consciousness is constituted at least partly by quiddities: intrinsic properties that categorically ground dispositional (or structural) properties described by fundamental physics.
There is no consensus among Russellian monists on exactly how quiddities are relevant to consciousness
